name: Hisaka Works, Ltd.
summary: Hisaka Works, Ltd. manufactures and sells industrial machinery in Japan, Asia, the Middle East, and internationally. It operates through Heat Exchanger, Process Engineering, and Valve segments. The Heat Exchanger segment offers multi gap plates, semi-welded plates, fin tubes, double-lined gasket plates, plate condensers, corrugated plate patterns, dual wall plates, and BHE for heating baths. This segment's products are used in various applications, such as general manufacturing, chemicals, pulp and paper, pure water, cooking oil, steelmaking, petroleum refining, ships, soda, electricity, beer, and sulfuric acid.
